<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="CoO-bhn-byGK9TVppHVp"> <mxGraphModel dx="2146" dy="1098" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "classDiagram
 class MissionType { <<enumeration>> }
 class MissionState { <<enumeration>> }
 class EmergencyType { <<enumeration>> }
 class EmergencyState { <<enumeration>> }

 class ResourceRequirement {
 -amounts : Map~ResourceType, Integer~
 +with(ResourceType type, int amount) ResourceRequirement
 +get(ResourceType type) int
 +asMap() Map~ResourceType, Integer~
 +isEmpty() boolean
 +toString() String
 }

 class Mission {
 <<interface>>
 +String RESPONSIBILITY = \"Represents a task assigned to colony agents.\"
 +getId() String
 +getType() MissionType
 +getState() MissionState
 +getDurationUnits() int
 +getProgressUnits() int
 +getFailureReason() String
 +getAssignedAgents() List~Agent~
 +getTargetFacilities() List~Facility~
 +getResourceRequirement() ResourceRequirement
 +getRequiredCapabilities() Set~Capability~
 +getRequiredSkill() Skill
 +getMinBatteryPercent() int
 +getRequiredEquipment() List~String~
 +requiresCommunication() boolean
 +requiresSurface() boolean
 +getStartBlockReason(EnvironmentCondition env) String
 +getInProgressFailureReason(EnvironmentCondition env) String
 +assign(List~Agent~ agents) void
 +start() void
 +advance() void
 +fail(String reason) void
 +isFinished() boolean
 +describe() String
 }

 class AbstractMission {
 <<abstract>>
 -id : String
 -type : MissionType
 -durationUnits : int
 -state : MissionState
 -progressUnits : int
 -failureReason : String
 -assignedAgents : List~Agent~
 -targetFacilities : List~Facility~
 -resourceRequirement : ResourceRequirement
 #AbstractMission(...)
 #onComplete() void
 }
 Mission <|.. AbstractMission

 class ExplorationMission {
 -regionName : String
 +ExplorationMission(...)
 +getRegionName() String
 }
 class RepairMission {
 +RepairMission(...)
 }
 class ResearchMission {
 +ResearchMission(...)
 }
 class RescueMission {
 +RescueMission(...)
 }
 AbstractMission <|-- ExplorationMission
 AbstractMission <|-- RepairMission
 AbstractMission <|-- ResearchMission
 AbstractMission <|-- RescueMission

 class AllocationPolicy {
 <<interface>>
 +order(List~Facility~ operationalFacilities, ResourceType type) List~Facility~
 }
 class StorageFirstPolicy {
 +order(List~Facility~ operationalFacilities, ResourceType type) List~Facility~
 }
 AllocationPolicy <|.. StorageFirstPolicy

 class SubmissionResult {
 +accepted(Mission mission)$ SubmissionResult
 +rejected(Mission mission, String reason)$ SubmissionResult
 +isAccepted() boolean
 +getReason() String
 +getMission() Mission
 +toString() String
 }

 class ResourceManager {
 +String RESPONSIBILITY = \"Manages facility inventory and resource consumption.\"
 -facilities : List~Facility~
 -policy : AllocationPolicy
 +ResourceManager(List~Facility~ facilities, AllocationPolicy policy)
 +setPolicy(AllocationPolicy policy) void
 +getTotal(ResourceType type) int
 +getAllTotals() Map~ResourceType, Integer~
 +canSupply(ResourceRequirement requirement) boolean
 +explainShortage(ResourceRequirement requirement) String
 +consume(ResourceRequirement requirement) boolean
 }
 ResourceManager --> AllocationPolicy

 class MarsColony {
 +String RESPONSIBILITY = \"Core colony hub coordinating resources and missions.\"
 -name : String
 -agents : List~Agent~
 -facilities : List~Facility~
 -resourceManager : ResourceManager
 -environment : Environment
 -activeMission : Mission
 -missionHistory : List~Mission~
 -eventLog : List~String~
 +MarsColony(String name, AllocationPolicy policy)
 +MarsColony(String name)
 +getName() String
 +addAgent(Agent agent) void
 +addFacility(Facility facility) void
 +getAgents() List~Agent~
 +getFacilities() List~Facility~
 +findFacility(String name) Facility
 +findAgent(String id) Agent
 +getAgentsAt(Location location) List~Agent~
 +hasOperationalCommunication() boolean
 +getEnvironment() Environment
 +getResourceManager() ResourceManager
 +submitMission(Mission mission, List~Agent~ agents) SubmissionResult
 +getActiveMission() Mission
 +getMissionHistory() List~Mission~
 +failActiveMission(String reason) boolean
 +changeEnvironment(EnvironmentCondition condition) void
 +tick() void
 +log(String message) void
 +getEventLog() List~String~
 }
 MarsColony *-- ResourceManager

 class Emergency {
 <<abstract>>
 +String RESPONSIBILITY = \"Critical event requiring immediate response and resources.\"
 -id : String
 -type : EmergencyType
 -location : Location
 -state : EmergencyState
 -reason : String
 -responders : List~Agent~
 #Emergency(String id, EmergencyType type, Location location)
 +getId() String
 +getType() EmergencyType
 +getLocation() Location
 +getState() EmergencyState
 +getReason() String
 +getResponders() List~Agent~
 +describe() String
 +getRequiredResponderCapabilities()* List~Capability~
 +getResponseResources()* ResourceRequirement
 #applyInitialEffects(MarsColony colony)* void
 #applyResolution(MarsColony colony)* void
 #applyUnresolvedPenalty(MarsColony colony)* void
 #checkPreconditions(MarsColony colony) String
 #isExcluded(Agent agent) boolean
 ~setState(EmergencyState state, String reason) void
 ~addResponder(Agent agent) void
 }

 class OxygenLeak {
 +OxygenLeak(String id, Habitat habitat, int oxygenLoss)
 }
 class Fire {
 +Fire(String id, Laboratory lab)
 }
 class RoverBreakdown {
 +RoverBreakdown(String id, ExplorationRover rover)
 }
 class MedicalEmergency {
 +MedicalEmergency(String id, CrewMember patient, int severity)
 }
 Emergency <|-- OxygenLeak
 Emergency <|-- Fire
 Emergency <|-- RoverBreakdown
 Emergency <|-- MedicalEmergency

 class EmergencyManager {
 -colony : MarsColony
 -history : List~Emergency~
 +EmergencyManager(MarsColony colony)
 +handle(Emergency emergency) Emergency
 +getHistory() List~Emergency~
 +getUnresolved() List~Emergency~
 }

 class Simulation {
 +String RESPONSIBILITY = \"Time management engine for the colony ecosystem.\"
 -colony : MarsColony
 -emergencyManager : EmergencyManager
 -currentTime : int
 -envChanges : List~ScheduledEnvChange~
 -emergencies : List~ScheduledEmergency~
 +Simulation(MarsColony colony)
 +getColony() MarsColony
 +getEmergencyManager() EmergencyManager
 +getCurrentTime() int
 +scheduleEnvironmentChange(int atTime, EnvironmentCondition condition) void
 +scheduleEmergency(int atTime, Emergency emergency) void
 +triggerEmergency(Emergency emergency) void
 +advanceTime(int units) void
 +advanceOneUnit() void
 +report() String
 }
 Simulation *-- EmergencyManager
 Simulation --> MarsColony

 %% External Stubs for Cross-Relationships
 class Agent { <<interface>> }
 class Facility { <<abstract>> }
 class Location { <<interface>> }
 class Environment

 MarsColony o-- \"1..*\" Agent
 MarsColony o-- \"1..*\" Facility
 MarsColony *-- Environment
 MarsColony --> \"0..1\" Mission : activeMission

 AbstractMission --> \"0..*\" Agent : assignedAgents
 AbstractMission --> \"0..*\" Facility : targetFacilities

 Emergency --> \"0..*\" Agent : responders
 Emergency --> Location : location",

 "data": "classDiagram
 class MissionType { <<enumeration>> }
 class MissionState { <<enumeration>> }
 class EmergencyType { <<enumeration>> }

 class ResourceRequirement {
 -amounts : Map~ResourceType, Integer~
 +with(ResourceType type, int amount) ResourceRequirement

 +asMap() Map~ResourceType, Integer~
 +isEmpty() boolean
 +toString() String
 }

 class Mission {
 <<interface>>
 +String RESPONSIBILITY = \"Represents a task assigned to colony agents.\"
 +getId() String
 +getType() MissionType
 +getState() MissionState
 +getDurationUnits() int
 +getProgressUnits() int
 +getFailureReason() String
 +getAssignedAgents() List~Agent~
 +getTargetFacilities() List~Facility~
 +getResourceRequirement() ResourceRequirement
 +getRequiredCapabilities() Set~Capability~
 +getRequiredSkill() Skill
 +getMinBatteryPercent() int
 +getRequiredEquipment() List~String~
 +requiresCommunication() boolean
 +requiresSurface() boolean
 +getStartBlockReason(EnvironmentCondition env) String
 +getInProgressFailureReason(EnvironmentCondition env) String
 +assign(List~Agent~ agents) void
 +start() void
 +advance() void
